trust_decision.summary: Nothing is decided in code: the dev runner's HTTP session-creating routes (POST /start, POST /api/offer, GET /daily) accept any caller; the only check is opt-in HMAC token auth on WebSocket routes (--ws-auth token, default none). The published fix adds no check, only a 'development purposes only' startup banner.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'unauthenticated bot session creation'; POST /start is the documented session-start route and spawns bot_module.bot at run.py:700.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The runner is documented and (after the fix) bannered as development-only, binds localhost by default (src/pipecat/runner/run.py:161), and offers opt-in --ws-auth; a solver can argue no auth is in scope at all.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Prebuilt client UI and telephony providers call /start, /api/offer, POST / and /ws without credentials; default --ws-auth none and empty --allowed-origins mean 'allow all' and must keep working for local dev.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /start spawns a bot (daily transport) or registers a session with no authentication
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Dev-only runner; project's fix was a banner, so no auth is part of the advisory's property

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/offer starts a bot over SmallWebRTC without auth or prior /start
GET /daily creates a Daily room and starts a bot without auth

O8b_injection_room.sibling: If an auth/host-binding check were added to /start, the /sessions/{id}/... proxy (run.py:834) and /api/offer would be natural missed siblings
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Routes are registered by separate _setup_* helpers per transport; a maintainer adding auth in one helper could easily skip another. But this requires us to invent the protection, since upstream never added one.

O9_family: missing authentication on development server exposure (CWE-862/CWE-345); upstream remediation is documentation-only

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Require a shared-secret/token on POST /start only, leaving /api/offer and /daily open.

out_of_scope_notes: The published fix has no behavioural change (print-only banner), so hidden behavioural tests cannot score a fix against upstream ground truth.
The pattern hint (resource-exhaustion DoS) does not match this advisory; CWE-770 here is only unbounded unauthenticated session creation.
unverified: O8 routes are listed as 'missing protection' only if one treats authentication as part of the advisory's property; upstream did not, so j_sibling_sites is unknown.
single_site is flagged because the fix changes one function plus its call and adds no protection; O8 entries depend on the interpretation above.
Whether advisory text recommends specific mitigations (reverse proxy, auth) was not available; only the diff was read.
